services.equipment: The lab supplies a VCR for North American NTSC VHS.
services.bring: Bring the tape and storage. Allow its running time plus setup and saving time. VPL recommends exFAT for individual files over 4 GB.

services.equipment: Central Library’s digitization cart converts VHS tapes. The equipment page does not specify NTSC/PAL or compact adapters.
services.bring: Bring your tape and physical library card. Ask about your exact format and file storage when requesting the cart.

services.equipment: Staff have MiniDV and 8 mm camcorder kits. The capture connection also accepts RCA or S-Video from a compatible camera.
services.bring: Bring the tape and storage. If using your camera, bring its power supply and connecting cables.

services.equipment: Central’s audio digitization station plays cassettes.
services.bring: Bring your cassette and storage for your digital copy.

services.equipment: Central’s digitization cart can transfer audio cassettes.
services.bring: Bring your cassette and physical library card. Include the format in your booking request.

services.equipment: Central’s digitization cart can transfer records.
services.bring: Bring the record and physical library card. Ask staff about the file output and storage you need.

services.equipment: The Inspiration Lab provides an Epson flatbed scanning station.
services.bring: Bring the originals and storage. Consult the image guide for holders and supported film sizes.

services.equipment: Book a sound booth at Central. The booking page describes the equipment in each room.
services.bring: Choose your booth and bring storage for your recording.

services.equipment: Central’s Media Studio offers recording space, microphones and audio editing software.
services.bring: Bring your physical library card. Watch the orientation videos before your first session.
